title: How to get the first and last day of the month
task: Snap any date to the start or end of its month — billing cycles, report ranges, month boundaries.

excel.note: First day. Last day is =EOMONTH(A2,0). Format the result cell as a date.

explanation: EOMONTH jumps to a month's last day: offset 0 gives this month's end, and offset -1 gives LAST month's end — add 1 to that and you land on the first day of the current month (July 1 for a July date). So first day = EOMONTH(date,-1)+1 and last day = EOMONTH(date,0). An alternative first-day formula is =DATE(YEAR(A2),MONTH(A2),1), which reads more literally. These two dates are the natural bounds for a month's SUMIFS date range or a report filter.
